list_child.name: list_program_matches
list_child.desc: Retrieves every mentor-youth match currently tracked by the program, whether it is proposed, active, paused, or closed. Use this when you need a full picture of the caseload across all pairings.

decoys.name: list_school_matches
decoys.desc: Retrieves every mentor-youth match currently tracked by the school-based site, whether it is proposed, active, paused, or closed. Use this when you need a full picture of the campus caseload across all pairings.

decoys.name: list_circle_matches
decoys.desc: Retrieves every mentor-youth match currently tracked by the group mentoring circles, whether it is proposed, active, paused, or closed. Use this when you need a full picture of the circle caseload across all pairings.

decoys.name: list_online_matches
decoys.desc: Retrieves every mentor-youth match currently tracked by the e-mentoring platform, whether it is proposed, active, paused, or closed. Use this when you need a full picture of the online caseload across all pairings.

get_child.name: get_match_record
get_child.desc: Retrieves the full detail for a single mentor-youth match using its id. This is the right call once you already know which match you need to inspect.

decoys.name: get_match_agreement
decoys.desc: Retrieves the signed match agreement for a single mentor-youth match using its id. This is the right call once you already know which match's goals you need to inspect.

decoys.name: get_match_survey
decoys.desc: Retrieves the latest relationship survey for a single mentor-youth match using its id. This is the right call once you already know which match's scores you need to inspect.

decoys.name: get_match_outings
decoys.desc: Retrieves the outing log for a single mentor-youth match using its id. This is the right call once you already know which match's activities you need to inspect.

list_parent.name: list_enrolled_mentors
list_parent.desc: Retrieves the full roster of mentors enrolled in the program, across every site and cohort. Use this to look up a mentor before creating or referencing a match.

decoys.name: list_applicant_mentors
decoys.desc: Retrieves the full roster of mentor applicants in screening, at every interview stage. Use this to look up an applicant before scheduling their training.

decoys.name: list_alumni_mentors
decoys.desc: Retrieves the full roster of mentors who have left the program, across every past cohort. Use this to look up a former mentor before inviting them back.

decoys.name: list_corporate_mentors
decoys.desc: Retrieves the full roster of mentors volunteering through employer partners, across every company. Use this to look up a mentor before reporting hours to their employer.

get_parent.name: get_mentor_record
get_parent.desc: Retrieves the full detail for a single mentor using their id. This is useful whenever you already have a mentor id and need their record.

decoys.name: get_mentor_training
decoys.desc: Retrieves the training transcript for a single mentor using their id. This is useful whenever you already have a mentor id and need their completed modules.

decoys.name: get_mentor_references
decoys.desc: Retrieves the reference letters for a single mentor using their id. This is useful whenever you already have a mentor id and need their referees' comments.

decoys.name: get_mentor_availability
decoys.desc: Retrieves the weekly availability for a single mentor using their id. This is useful whenever you already have a mentor id and need their open time slots.

delete_child.name: delete_match_record
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a mentor-youth match record from the program's system, and the action cannot be reversed once it runs. This is meant for records created in error, such as a duplicate or mistyped pairing.

decoys.name: delete_match_photos
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the outing photos stored on a mentor-youth match, and the action cannot be reversed once it runs. This is meant for images uploaded in error, such as a shot of the wrong youth.

decoys.name: delete_match_messages
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the text message history of a mentor-youth match, and the action cannot be reversed once it runs. This is meant for threads flagged by safeguarding, such as an inappropriate exchange.

decoys.name: shred_match_file
decoys.desc: Permanently shreds the paper case file for a mentor-youth match, and the action cannot be reversed once it runs. This is meant for files past their retention date, such as an old intake packet.

set_enum.name: set_match_phase
set_enum.desc: Changes a match's phase to proposed, active, paused, or closed so the caseload reflects where the pairing currently stands. Use this whenever a match moves forward, pauses, or wraps up.

decoys.name: set_target_phase
decoys.desc: Sets the phase a match should reach by its next quarterly review, among proposed, active, paused, or closed, so supervisors can track goals. Use this whenever a coordinator plans a match's next step.

decoys.name: set_rematch_phase
decoys.desc: Changes the phase of a match's rematch request to proposed, active, paused, or closed so the caseload reflects where the replacement search stands. Use this whenever a rematch moves forward, pauses, or wraps up.

decoys.name: set_group_phase
decoys.desc: Changes the phase of a match's group activity enrollment to proposed, active, paused, or closed so the caseload reflects where the outing plan stands. Use this whenever the group plan moves forward, pauses, or wraps up.

set_bool.name: flag_needs_new_mentor
set_bool.desc: Flags a match as needing reassignment to a new mentor, which coordinators use when a pairing is failing. This should be reserved for matches that genuinely need to be restarted.

decoys.name: flag_needs_home_visit
decoys.desc: Flags a match as needing a home visit from a case worker, which coordinators use when a family raises a concern. This should be reserved for matches that warrant an in-person check.
verbs: flag {obj} as needing a home visit

decoys.name: flag_needs_safety_review
decoys.desc: Flags a match as needing a safeguarding review, which coordinators use when a boundary concern is reported. This should be reserved for matches with a documented incident.
verbs: mark {obj} as needing a safeguarding review

decoys.name: flag_needs_parent_meeting
decoys.desc: Flags a match as needing a three-way meeting with the parent, which coordinators use when expectations have drifted. This should be reserved for matches where the family asks to talk.
verbs: mark {obj} as needing a family meeting

set_ref.name: reassign_mentor
set_ref.desc: Moves a match onto a different mentor's caseload, which is useful when a pairing needs to be handled by someone else entirely. The match keeps its focus area and phase after the move.

decoys.name: cover_mentor
decoys.desc: Assigns a different mentor to cover a match's meetings, which is useful when the regular mentor is travelling or on leave. The cover lasts until the regular mentor returns.
verbs: give the meetings for {obj} {to_name} as cover

decoys.name: buddy_mentor
decoys.desc: Pairs a match with a different mentor as a peer buddy, which is useful when a new mentor wants to shadow an experienced one. The buddy can see the match's meeting log.

decoys.name: tutor_mentor
decoys.desc: Refers a match's youth to a different mentor for extra tutoring, which is useful when schoolwork needs a specialist. The tutoring runs alongside the regular meetings.
verbs: refer the youth in {obj} {to_name} for tutoring

send.name: email_mentor
send.desc: Sends an email to a mentor's address on file, letting them know about a status change or asking them to check in with their match. This is the main way coordinators reach mentors outside of scheduled meetings.
child_verbs: follow up with the mentor on {obj}

decoys.name: text_mentor
decoys.desc: Sends a text message to a mentor's phone on file, reminding them about an upcoming outing or asking them to confirm a meeting. This is the quickest way coordinators reach mentors on the day of an activity.
child_verbs: send a text to the mentor on {obj}

decoys.name: survey_mentor
decoys.desc: Sends a match satisfaction survey to a mentor's address on file, asking them to rate how the pairing is going and what support they need. This is the main way coordinators collect quarterly feedback.
child_verbs: send a satisfaction survey to the mentor on {obj}

decoys.name: thank_mentor
decoys.desc: Sends a thank-you card to a mentor's mailing address on file, recognizing a milestone in their match or a year of service. This is the main way coordinators show appreciation to volunteers.
child_verbs: send a thank-you card to the mentor on {obj}

create.name: create_match
create.desc: Creates a new mentor-youth match for a mentor, with an optional focus area and starting phase. Use this when a coordinator proposes a new pairing.

decoys.name: create_outing
decoys.desc: Creates a new group outing for a mentor, with an optional focus area and starting phase. Use this when a coordinator plans an activity day.

decoys.name: create_referral
decoys.desc: Creates a new youth referral for a mentor, with an optional focus area and starting phase. Use this when a school sends a young person to the program.

decoys.name: create_training
decoys.desc: Creates a new training enrollment for a mentor, with an optional focus area and starting phase. Use this when a coordinator books a volunteer onto a course.

list_notes.name: list_match_notes
list_notes.desc: Retrieves the case notes attached to a single match. Use this to read every remark coordinators have logged about the pairing so far.

decoys.name: list_match_contacts
decoys.desc: Retrieves the contact logs attached to a single match. Use this to read every check-in call coordinators have logged about the pairing so far.

decoys.name: list_match_goals
decoys.desc: Retrieves the goal entries attached to a single match. Use this to read every target the mentor and youth have set for the pairing so far.

decoys.name: list_match_incidents
decoys.desc: Retrieves the incident reports attached to a single match. Use this to read every safeguarding concern staff have logged about the pairing so far.

add_note.name: add_match_note
add_note.desc: Attaches a new case note to a match, with an optional title. Use this to record a coordinator's remark about how the pairing is going.

decoys.name: add_match_contact
decoys.desc: Logs a new contact entry on a match, with an optional title. Use this to record a coordinator's check-in call with the mentor or family.

decoys.name: add_match_goal
decoys.desc: Adds a new goal entry to a match, with an optional title. Use this to record a target the mentor and youth agreed to work toward.

decoys.name: add_match_incident
decoys.desc: Files a new incident report on a match, with an optional title. Use this to record a safeguarding concern raised during an outing.

update_note.name: edit_match_note
update_note.desc: Changes the text, and optionally the title, of an existing case note on a match. Use this to correct or expand a remark after it has been logged.

decoys.name: reply_match_note
decoys.desc: Posts a reply, with an optional title, under an existing case note on a match. Use this to answer a remark after another coordinator has logged it.

decoys.name: approve_match_note
decoys.desc: Approves an existing case note on a match with a supervisor's comment and an optional title. Use this to sign off a remark during case review.

decoys.name: escalate_match_note
decoys.desc: Escalates an existing case note on a match to the program director, with a comment and an optional title. Use this when a remark needs a decision from above.

delete_note.name: delete_match_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently deletes a case note from a match, and the action cannot be reversed once it runs. Use this to clear a remark logged against the wrong pairing.

decoys.name: redact_match_note
decoys.desc: Permanently redacts the wording of a case note on a match, and the action cannot be reversed once it runs. Use this to strip a youth's personal details from a remark.

decoys.name: purge_match_thread
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes a case note and every reply under it from a match, and the action cannot be reversed once it runs. Use this to clear a whole discussion from the file.

decoys.name: retract_match_incident
decoys.desc: Permanently retracts an incident report filed on a match, and the action cannot be reversed once it runs. Use this when a concern was reported against the wrong pairing.

set_image.name: set_match_image
set_image.desc: Sets the image shown on a match record. This is typically a photo of the mentor and youth taken at their first meeting.

decoys.name: set_match_release
decoys.desc: Sets the photo release scan shown on a match record. This is typically the parent's signed consent form collected at intake.

decoys.name: set_match_certificate
decoys.desc: Sets the milestone certificate shown on a match record. This is typically the one-year anniversary award presented to the pair.

decoys.name: set_match_collage
decoys.desc: Sets the outing collage shown on a match record. This is typically the scrapbook page the pair made at the end of the season.

writer.name: draft_text
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the matches it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_update
decoys.desc: Writes a short funder update from a brief, which states the progress in the requester's own words, and the matches it should highlight. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_story
decoys.desc: Writes a short success story from a brief, which states the highlights in the requester's own words, and the matches it should feature. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_summary
decoys.desc: Writes a short case summary from a brief, which states the concerns in the coordinator's own words, and the matches it should cover. It returns the finished text.

image.name: make_image
image.desc: Generates an image from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: find_image
decoys.desc: Finds a program archive image matching a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: make_flyer
decoys.desc: Generates a recruitment flyer from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the layout.

decoys.name: make_video
decoys.desc: Generates a short promo video from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the clip.

search.name: lookup_docs
search.desc: Searches the help docs and knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up how the program's system works.

decoys.name: lookup_policies
decoys.desc: Searches the safeguarding policies and program standards with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up what a mentor may do.

decoys.name: lookup_curriculum
decoys.desc: Searches the activity guides and match curriculum with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up an outing idea for a pair.

decoys.name: lookup_resources
decoys.desc: Searches the community resource directory and referral lists with a question and returns the best matching passage. Use this to look up help for a family.
